title: Successor label of a site
statement: The successor label assigns to the sites, respectively: increment the vertex register at the first input site; begin the gate scan at the final input site; test the gate kind at the first gate site; begin the output scan at the final gate site; emit the second site of each of the three kind-test pairs at the first site of that pair; begin the argument scan at the second site of each pair; clear the work register at the first argument site; increment the work register at the first unary-input site; begin the next argument at the final unary-input site; increment the vertex register at the final argument site; increment the output-scan register at the first output site; and halt at the final output site.
